title: Splashes in brisk sunlit stints of battle. Water flies in smiles painted' arcs dancing in skies Laughter swims in buckets of cool ammunition #smallpoe
summary: Splashes in brisk sunlit stints of battle. Water flies in smiles painted' arcs dancing in skies Laughter swims in buckets of cool ammunition #smallpoems #poemsofpresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Splashes
  in brisk
sunlit stints
of battle.

Water flies
in smiles
painted'
arcs
dancing
in skies

Laughter swims
in buckets
of cool
ammunition
#smallpoems
#poemsofpresence
